description: P(model has an exact reference CDS). HistGradientBoostingClassifier depth 3, 400 iterations, learning rate 0.05, trained on the keep-all pools of 15 validation species (clade-agnostic). raw = baseline + sum of leaf values; P = 1 / (1 + exp(-raw)). Node test: x <= thr -> left; NaN -> left if nan_left else right.
